content: mind the metal feathers when screwing in the two svrews. dont place the part on them.

Same issues as others I think the part tolerance is a bit too big on these holes as I did not get great positive "tight" when I got to the end like on every other part so far. Watch out to go until the part doesn't move and don't keep tightening!

I was unable to tighten any of three the screws into the vent-lever holder part (i.e., the screws  kept spinning, no purchase at the end). Not sure if the screw hole tolerances on this part are off, but that was my experience.
